The Supplier shall indemnify the Customer against third-party intellectual property infringement claims.
The Supplier shall maintain professional liability insurance of INR 2,000,000 and retain certificates.
Neither party is liable for delays caused by natural disasters beyond its reasonable control. The affected party must promptly notify the other party.
Service quality issues are discussed at the monthly review. Separate credit terms are specified in a schedule.
Service Credit. A service credit of INR 500 applies for each hour of unplanned downtime.
Termination requires thirty days written notice from either party.
Termination requires sixty days written notice from either party.
Following written notice of breach, the defaulting party has thirty days to remedy the breach before termination.
